description: Every dependency, pinned and moved by one bot. Policy: docs/launch/deploy-checklist.md, Updates.

packageRules.description: Images: base-image rebuilds and Postgres/Node minors. Its own PR, so a broken npm update never holds back an OS security fix.
An image digest has no release date, so a minimum age would hold it forever; a rebuild of the same tag is how Debian's and Alpine's security fixes arrive.
Actions: new releases, aged seven days like everything else.
An action's digest moving under the same version tag means the tag was moved, which is how a compromised action spreads. A person reads it.
npm: dependencies, devDependencies and pnpm itself (packageManager).
Nothing tests the UI, so a Next.js minor is read before it merges.
A Postgres major needs pg_upgrade on the data volume; it is a runbook, not a PR.
A Node major moves the image and every workflow together.
